_note: DATA-7. public/data/sauce_augment.json is the hand-curated source of the sauces (no script writes it; proDataset/scripts/10-derive-sauce-clusters.js only reads it), but it is not edited here: the 27 sauces it tags motherSauce 'Independent' are regrouped by this table, applied by applySauceCuration (src/data/curation/applySauceCuration.js) wherever the sauces are loaded. One entry per sauce with the reason. 'groups' are the new Sauce Lab groups (each needs at least three sauces; 'Independent' is the catch-all that remains). DATA-8 does not mirror this: nothing in proDataset/ reads the groups.

groups.name: Dipping Sauces
groups.blurb: thin soy, citrus and vinegar sauces for dipping and finishing

groups.name: Chili & Hot Sauces
groups.blurb: chili-led pastes, hot sauces and spice pastes

groups.name: Herb Sauces
groups.blurb: raw, loose sauces built on fresh herbs, oil and acid

groups.name: Cold & Creamy
groups.blurb: cold sauces held by mayonnaise, yogurt or tahini

groups.name: Sweet & Tangy
groups.blurb: sugar and vinegar table sauces, chutneys and reductions

groups.name: Independent
groups.blurb: sauces that fit no group above

Ponzu.reason: soy, citrus and dashi, thin and served as a dip; the old lab filed it under Stir-fry

Tare.reason: soy, mirin and sake reduced to a seasoning sauce; not a stir-fry sauce itself

Nuoc Cham.reason: fish sauce, lime and sugar, thin and served as a dip

Gochujang Sauce.reason: built on gochujang, a fermented chili paste

Harissa.reason: a dried-chili paste; the old lab filed it under Mole

Adobo Sauce.reason: a dried-chili paste; the old lab filed it under Mole

Shito.reason: a chili and dried-shrimp oil paste, not a curry

Berbere Sauce.reason: a berbere chili-spice paste; kept with the chili pastes rather than the curries

Buffalo Sauce.reason: cayenne hot sauce with butter; the butter makes it look like a hollandaise but it is a hot sauce

Chimichurri.reason: parsley, oregano, oil and vinegar, raw

Zhug.reason: cilantro and green chili ground raw with oil

Chermoula.reason: cilantro, parsley and spice blended raw with oil and lemon

Mint Chutney.reason: mint and cilantro ground raw with lime

Ají Amarillo Sauce.reason: cilantro and lime with aji amarillo, blended raw

Toum.reason: a cold garlic and oil emulsion

Remoulade.reason: mayonnaise with capers and herbs, served cold

Tahini Sauce.reason: sesame paste loosened with lemon and water, served cold

BBQ Sauce.reason: ketchup, sugar and vinegar table sauce

Tonkatsu Sauce.reason: ketchup, worcestershire and sugar table sauce

Sofrito.reason: a tomato and onion base simmered down; kept in Tomato where the old lab already had it

Gravy (Southern).reason: butter, flour and milk: a milk gravy is a béchamel; kept where the old lab already had it

Beurre Noisette.reason: browned butter with lemon and capers: a butter sauce, but not an egg emulsion, so not a hollandaise (the old lab put it there)

Dashi.reason: a stock of kombu and bonito, not a roux-thickened velouté (the old lab put it there)
